_comment: jarvis#823 - the ONE contract for the chat turn error taxonomy.
Read by NEITHER side at runtime: it is the fixture both test suites assert
their own table against, so the Python taxonomy (jarvis/chat/error_taxonomy.py)
and the JS taxonomy (frontend/src/lib/errors.js) cannot drift the way the
three hand-synced copies did in jarvis#757 and jarvis#760.
`codes` pins the taxonomy and which failures a Retry button may appear on.
`markers` pins the text ladder both sides run for a message row written
before #823, which has an error string and no code - if those two ladders
disagree, one failure reads differently before and after a page refresh,
which is the exact defect #823 exists to close.
Adding a code or a marker means editing THREE files in one commit: this one,
the Python table, and the JS table. Both suites go red until all three agree.

overflow: reduce the length of the messages
